### Gate result: PASS

Every design decision was probed against the spec before being written down. Findings worth your attention:

- **All 22 phone acceptance scenarios/edge cases pass** with `\+[0-9]{8,15}(?![0-9])` applied as a fourth stage over the gaps ranks 1–3 left. `+4222222222222` stays `+[CARD]`, so FR-005 holds literally. Feature 001's 221 tests pass unchanged at baseline; worst adversarial line is 6.78 ms against a 1 s budget.
- **`_partition` has a real bug waiting for `--out-dir`.** Its current docstring assumes no option takes a value; without the fix, `--out-dir clean app.log` would silently treat `clean` as an input path. Fixed by a value-taking-option table rather than `allow_abbrev=False`, which would have changed existing `--cou` behaviour.
- **`os.makedirs(mode=0o700)` sets the mode on the leaf only** — measured `0755` on every intermediate, which would have failed SC-007 for the nested-DIR case the spec requires. Hence the explicit per-component `mkdir` + `chmod`.
- **`open(path, "w")` is unusable here**: it truncates before any check can run (so `--out-dir .` would destroy the input the tool is reading), follows symlinks, can't set a creation mode, and hangs on a planted FIFO. The nine-step `os.open` sequence with no `O_TRUNC` and `ftruncate` last fixes all four; each attack was planted and verified to fail loudly with the target untouched.

**One deviation, justified rather than waived**: the target platform narrows to POSIX, because `O_NOFOLLOW`/`fchmod` are Unix-only and a `getattr` fallback would leave the symlink guard silently absent while the tool reported success. Recorded in Complexity Tracking — flagging it since feature 001 claimed "any platform with CPython 3.11+".
